title: Write analytical solution tests
objective: Create tests/test_analytical.py with tests for all four analytical solution functions: patch_test_reference, rigid_body_reference, cantilever_euler_bernoulli, uniaxial_tension_hardening.
implementation_steps: Test patch_test_reference: constant strain → exact displacement, zero strain → zero displacement
Test rigid_body_reference: R=I → zero, known rotation → correct displacement
Test cantilever: known params → known δ
Test uniaxial: below yield, above yield, continuity at yield, large strain
acceptance_criteria: Each function has at least 2 test cases
verification_commands: uv run pytest packages/mechdsl-core/tests/test_ref_elastic.py packages/mechdsl-core/tests/test_ref_plastic.py -v -k 'patch or rigid or cantilever or uniaxial'
risks: Test file depends on all four analytical functions — partial implementations may cause import errors
